<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/chat/conversations/{conversationId}/read"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Updates the caller's read position for the currently accessible
`FAMILY` or `PRIVATE` conversation. This route requires server feature
`directMessages`; an inaccessible private conversation returns `404`.
